2393-4279-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

654-2577-4247-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2577-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-3249-5457-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5457-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

549-1651-4659-5261-8116.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Frontline Rush without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Frontline Rush, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Biotransference.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

1981-2415-5231-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5231-7399.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

620-2111-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1947-3327-4613-7940.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4613-7940.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1479-3147-7885.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1978-4324-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-4324-7826.description:
Animate Bag End Banquet using Workshop Elders.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bag End Banquet.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-3277-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Izzet Chronarch.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Izzet Chronarch from exile to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1809-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Returned Pastcaller.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Returned Pastcaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3179-4399-4770-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3179-4399-4770-6458.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-6458.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3375-4200-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5477-5660-7297-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1495-6996.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Triskelion lifelink.
1495-6996.description:
Give Triskelion lifelink.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

147-5147-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5147-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-6556-7101.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
141-6556-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.

3165-3532-5078-6747.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
You control another artifact.
3165-3532-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5696-5702-6965.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5696-5702-6965.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1805-1978-3007.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.

Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5220-5651.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

132-3609--127.easyPrerequisites: Other creatures you control have total power 3 or greater.
132-3609--127.description:
Activate Myr Welder using a Spacecraft's station ability by tapping a creature you control, putting a number of charge counters on Myr Welder equal to the creature's power.
If necessary, repeat step 1 until Myr Welder has three or more charge counters on it.
Activate Myr Welder using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2557-2957-4508-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2390-3372-6824.description:
Animate All Will Be One with Zur.
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

483-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

804-2533-4050-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

1336-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
1336-3869-4067.description:

Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.

Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2034-3426-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Deranged Hermit that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Deranged Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

283-2178-4214-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least two spore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff and Illusionist's Bracers attached to Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
283-2178-4214-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, targeting Utopia Mycon.
Illusionists's Bracers triggers, copying Vorel of the Hull Clade's ability, targeting Utopia Mycon.
Resolve the copy of Vorel of the Hull Clade's ability, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Resolve the original Vorel of the Hull Clade ability, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{U}.
When the Saporlings die, Vorel of the Hull Clade triggers twice, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Utopia Mycon has three or more spore counters on it to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon, which you may remove for infinite Saproling tokens and/or colored mana, or target another creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.

Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Foods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.

Paradox Engine triggers, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
If applicable, activate any number of nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}.

575-1794-4187.description:

Ruthless Ripper dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Ruthless Ripper trigger from step 1, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

573-1479-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-4288.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1061-2713-4118-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {2}{B}, returning Timestream Navigator from your graveyard to your battlefield.
Activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, causing all creatures to gain haste.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to an extra turn after this one.
Activate Oriq Loremage by tapping it, searching for Timestream Navigator and put it into your graveyard.
Repeat.
